texts.value: Electrogenic Na(+)-coupled sugar symporter that may play a primary role in D-mannose and possibly D-fructose and D-glucose transport at the plasma membrane. Transporter activity is driven by a transmembrane Na(+) electrochemical gradient set by the Na(+)/K(+) pump. Exclusively recognizes sugar substrates having a pyranose ring with an axial hydroxyl group on carbon 2
